ios_crash_gate.reason: Two device system reports recovered read-only on 2026-09-04 prove that exact TestFlight 1.1.0 (9) crashed on the iPad at 2026-09-03 13:45 and 14:49 +05:00. Both reports name the main `Nimbo` process rather than `NimboWidget`, match app/dSYM UUID 86A2A899-D90D-3820-B9FF-E4F35D0C19BF, and show EXC_BREAKPOINT/SIGTRAP on `com.apple.root.default-qos` through `_dispatch_assert_queue_fail` and `_swift_task_checkIsolatedSwift`. Exact-dSYM symbolication resolves the path to the inline completion in `AppDelegate.handleBackgroundRefresh(_:)`, the Swift-to-Kotlin thunk, and `startCancellableBackgroundRefresh` at BackgroundWeatherUpdater.kt:90. Read-only TestFlight build detail separately reports 2 installs, 7 sessions, and 3 crashes for exact build 9; the group aggregate of 22 sessions and 8 crashes spans builds, and only two raw iPad reports were recovered and symbolicated. Build 9 created a MainActor-isolated Swift closure inside `@MainActor AppDelegate`, then Kotlin invoked it from Dispatchers.Default before its inner actor hop could run. Source authority fc4b6de9e28fd8956eb64462294b8bcdf405ce7e moves the outer completion and expiration callbacks into nonisolated `@Sendable` factories, explicitly hops to MainActor, and advances Apple to build 10. Protected run 33852229166 signed and candidate-byte-verified build 10, but the artifact is not yet durably materialized, independently trusted, uploaded, or exercised through TestFlight. Build 9 is approved in Pending Developer Release under manual release and must remain unreleased. Public 1.0.1 also still lacks a source-defined crash-free-session window. The gate remains blocked.
